nonRedirectSurfaces.reason: Unknown paths are rendered by the Angular wildcard route with a real 404 and a noindex meta. Swallowing unknown URLs into the home page, a hub or a login page is prohibited.
nonRedirectSurfaces.observed: Isolated local SSR run 2026-11-02: /marea and /en/marea answered 404 with no Location and a noindex body. /productos/does-not-exist answered 404 with Location: /tecnologia/does-not-exist and an empty body (inherited Angular redirect behaviour); it is not a redirect.
nonRedirectSurfaces.note: The empty-body 404 with a Location header bypasses the NotFound noindex surface; recorded as inherited behaviour and out of MC-15 change scope.

nonRedirectSurfaces.reason: When a legacy product slug has no TECHNOLOGY counterpart the router does not redirect; the request is answered 404 at the legacy URL. That prevents a 301 to a 404 destination. Only a per-slug verified mapping may ever change this, and no such change is authorised in MC-15.
nonRedirectSurfaces.observed: Isolated local SSR run 2026-11-02: /productos/does-not-exist answered 404 with Location: /tecnologia/does-not-exist, an empty body and no noindex meta. This is the inherited Angular redirect leaving a Location header on a 404, not a 3xx redirect; the no-301-to-a-404-destination invariant holds.
nonRedirectSurfaces.note: Inherited empty-body 404 + Location behaviour; no routing change is authorised in MC-15.

nonRedirectSurfaces.reason: The API is disallowed in robots.txt and is not an HTML surface; no redirect, canonical or hreflang applies. Robots.txt is not an access control and is not used as a substitute for authorisation.
